description: Drone physical and control parameters for Quadcopter_SimCon. Keys starting with '_' are comments only.

drone._dxm: Arm length in x direction (m), motor 1–2 and 3–4
drone._dym: Arm length in y direction (m), motor 1–4 and 2–3
drone._IRzz: Rotor moment of inertia about spin axis (kg·m²)
drone._kTh: Thrust coefficient: thrust (N) = kTh × (rad/s)² per motor
drone._HoverThr: Thrust for hover as fraction of max (0–1); maxThr = mB×g/HoverThr
drone._tau: Time constant for second-order motor dynamics (s)
drone._useIntergral: Use integral term in velocity controller

control._pos_P_gain: Position P gains [Px, Py, Pz] (outer position loop). From reference RL/t ctrl.py: Px=Py*0.8=0.56, Py=0.7, Pz=3
control._vel_P_gain: Velocity P gains [Pxdot, Pydot, Pzdot]. From reference RL/t ctrl.py
control._vel_D_gain: Velocity D gains. From reference RL/t ctrl.py
control._vel_I_gain: Velocity I gains (integral). From reference RL/t ctrl.py
control._vel_FF_gain: Velocity feed-forward gains. From reference RL/t ctrl.py
control._vel_FF_dot_gain: Velocity derivative feed-forward gains. From reference RL/t ctrl.py
control._vel_sp_dot_lpf_cutoff: Low-pass filter cutoff (Hz) for velocity setpoint derivative
control._att_P_gain: Attitude P gains [Pphi, Ptheta, Ppsi] (roll, pitch, yaw). From reference RL/t ctrl.py
control._rate_P_gain: Angular rate P gains [Pp, Pq, Pr]. From reference RL/t: Pp=Pq=0.2, Pr=3
control._rate_D_gain: Angular rate D gains. From reference RL/t ctrl.py
control._rate_FF_gain: Rate feed-forward gain. From reference RL/t ctrl.py
control._rate_FF_dot_gain: Rate derivative feed-forward gain. From reference RL/t ctrl.py
control._velMax: Max velocity setpoint per axis [u, v, w] (m/s)
control._saturateVel_separetely: If true, saturate each axis separately; else scale to velMaxAll
control._tiltMax_deg: Max tilt angle (deg); converted to rad internally
control._rateMax_deg_s: Max angular rate setpoint [p, q, r] (deg/s); converted to rad/s internally
